description: How many drums, IBCs, bags or ISO tanks a quantity needs, from KORKİMYA product packaging data (same logic as the korkimya.com/araclar order calculators). calculator: 'dmea' (DMEA (Dimetiletanolamin)), 'dea99' (Dietanolamin Saf (DEA)), 'c9' (C9 Hidrokarbon Reçine), 'metilen' (Diklorometan (Metilen Klorür)), 'tofa' (TOFA (Tall Oil Yağ Asidi)). Counts are rounded up to whole packages; bulk options return no count. Commercial terms are quotation-only.
